name: tradeflow
description: TradeFlow — a bilingual (Arabic/English) B2B wholesale management platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @tradeflow/api" "npm run dev -w @tradeflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tradeflow/api && npm run build -w @tradeflow/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @tradeflow/api && npm run test:e2e -w @tradeflow/api && npm run test -w @tradeflow/web
